blocks.text: Gravitational waves (GWs) asal mein yeh hain:

blocks.title: Gravitational waves
blocks.text: Spacetime (space aur time ka mila hua kapra) mein ripples (lehrein), jo violent (shadeed) cosmic (kaainati) events (waqiaat), jaise black holes ya neutron stars ke takrane, se paida hoti hain, light ki speed se chalti hain aur apne source ki information (maloomat) saath le jati hain.
GWs samajhne ki sab se aasan misal yeh hai:

Agar hum talab mein patthar phenkein to pani ki surface (satah), yani spacetime, par waves banti hain. Yeh waves bahar ki taraf phailti hain aur patthar (cosmic event) ki information saath le jati hain. Kinare par (gravitational wave observatories mein) inhein pakar kar patthar ke hone aur us ki properties (khoobiyon) ka pata chalta hai.
